headline_changes: Python 3.11 is now required across all packages. This release adds a Conversation object for carrying state between runs, unified cross-provider prompt caching, and hosted Postgres stores for messages and media. Durable execution now records more tool calls, while fixes improve recovery after interrupted runs and prevent repeated writes.

Fixes prevent updates to older checkpoints from affecting other branches and avoid replaying abandoned branches into DeltaChannel forks. DeltaChannel counters are preserved across update_state paths, subgraph delta channels use the caller-resolved saver, and get_state no longer reports answered interrupts.

Page sync now streams progress, supports cancellation, and reports failed page paths and causes. Workflow steps can emit progress events through AgentOS streaming. Fixes improve retries for transient page-fetch failures and prevent incomplete syncs on Mintlify-style sites from leaving removed pages searchable.

OpenAI live sessions can reconnect after a drop, and GPT-Live now supports WebSearchTool. Compatibility changes include ending runs on unexpected BackgroundTools exceptions and disabling RepoContext inventory by default. Fixes improve run-state recovery after cancellation or Ctrl-C and prevent BubblewrapWorkspace commands from executing code on the SSH host.

Adds AgentOS role-based access control, a database-backed filesystem with file routes, and AIMLAPITools for image, video, speech and transcription. Breaking changes: existing DbFileSystem tables require a manual migration to the new key, and MCP default and lifecycle tools are now opt-in. Notable fixes address duplicated paused runs during HITL continuation and recovery when a chained OpenAI response is gone.
Release tests and readiness checks were fixed without changing SDK runtime behavior. Default integration and automatic example runs now skip external-provider cases unless explicitly opted in.

Fixed a high-severity concurrency-limiter issue that could block requests after streamed requests, with changes to limiter-sharing and custom-limiter behavior. Added ToolCallJudge to assess tool calls before execution and AskUser support for deferring questions to the host. Deprecated pydantic_ai_harness.step_persistence.naming.
Added `response_schema` support to `interrupt()`. Fixed typing for undeclared v3 stream projections and changed subgraph detection to use bytecode instead of source.

Web search tools now support image results, MCP tools can use server-wide guardrails, and Unix-local sandbox environment isolation is configurable. Notable fixes improve recovery of resumed session writes, preserve concurrent writes during compaction, and redact speech prompts and instructions from traces.

Added support for newer Claude and GPT models, multimodal AG-UI input, async LLM reranking, and MCP 2.x. Notable fixes preserve chat history and ingestion nodes, correct property-graph search behavior, and prevent HWP decompression from exceeding bounds.
